headline: Nigerian Actress And Researcher Olatunde Ogunsola-Oluyemi Has Died
metaDescription: Olatunde Ogunsola-Oluyemi, an actress, screenwriter, and daughter of theatre icons Ishow Pepper and Iya Efunsetan, has passed away at age.
aiSummaryBullets: Olatunde Ogunsola-Oluyemi, known for her work as an actress, screenwriter, and translator, has passed away.
The deceased was the daughter of the late veteran Nigerian actors Ishow Pepper and Iya Efunsetan.
Her professional portfolio included contributions to several theatrical and television productions, such as Eja and Okoto The Series.
aiContextParagraph: Olatunde Ogunsola-Oluyemi was a Nigerian cultural researcher, screenwriter, and actress who gained professional recognition for her involvement in various media projects. Among her notable appearances were roles in the series Okoto and the production Eja. Beyond her performance work, she served as a translator and researcher, contributing to the broader arts and culture landscape in Nigeria. She was the daughter of two prominent figures in the Nigerian theatre industry: the late Ishow Pepper and Iya Efunsetan, both of whom were recognized for their long-standing contributions to the country's acting community. News of her death was confirmed on Monday, November 16, 2026. While details regarding the circumstances of her passing remain limited, her death follows the established legacy of her parents, marking a significant loss for those familiar with the family’s historical impact on local theatre and television productions.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked across two independent media outlets with moderate coverage velocity.
